issues: Document title in the source is 'DİAMOND  Snack Menü' (not Premium Pool); the file is named Premium_pool_2025_snack_menu. The content may be a copy of the Diamond Pool menu (a separate file diamond_2025_snack_menu_1_docx.txt exists, not compared). Confirm with the hotel that this is really the Premium Pool menu.
No prices anywhere in the document: priceUsd is null for all items.

Most item names are printed in one language only (e.g. 'Royal tost', 'Steak Sandwich', 'PIZZA ROYAL', 'Tekirdağ bowl', 'Spagetti Bolonez', 'Mac and cheese', 'Royal Burger'); copied into tr and en. Same-text pairs ('Lahmacun / Lahmacun', 'Waffle / Waffle', 'San sebastian cheesecake / San sebastian cheesecake') kept as printed.

'Mantar soslu Tavuklu Tagliatelli / Şarap soslu kremalı,mantarlı tavuklu Tagliatelli': both halves are Turkish (alternative names, not TR/EN); stored as tr and en as printed. Only an English description is printed, so detailTr is null.

Piliç Şinitsel: the line 'Hardallı patates salatası , Sauteed vegetables, butter and chili sauce' mixes Turkish and English and sits after Piliç Şinitsel; stored in both detailTr and detailEn. Unclear whether it describes Piliç Külbastı, Piliç Şinitsel or both. Kasap Köfte, Kuzu şiş, Piliç Külbastı have no description.
'Mercimek Çorbası - Lentil Soup' was split at ' - '. The '*' soup note (TR and EN) is stored as the note of Çorbalar and in footnotes.

'*Tercihinize göre sarımsaklı ve sarımsaksız servis edilir. / Create your own with garlic or with out garlic' sits right after Türkmen mantısı inside Makarnalar; treated as a serving note of the whole Makarnalar category (also in footnotes) but it may only belong to Türkmen mantısı.
Çoban salatası: the unmarked line 'Lütfen soğan tercihinizi belirtiniz / Please specify your onion preference' was appended to the item's detail after ' — ' (also listed in footnotes).
SARIMSAKLI TEREYAĞLI EKMEK has no heading of its own and follows the pizzas; kept inside Pizza.

Pizza Quattro Stagioni: TR description wraps onto two lines ('...enginar ve' / 'Zeytinler'), joined with a space. Izgara Levrek Salatası: TR and EN descriptions each wrap onto two lines, joined with a space.
Browni: name contains '(Ilık Servis Edilir)'; stored tr 'Browni (Ilık Servis Edilir)', en 'Brownie warm serve for you'. Heading 'Tatlı / Desert' keeps the source spelling 'Desert'.

Typos kept as printed (examples): Shepperd, chesee, souce, bilka, bolief, Buritto, Guacamela, Commo, Fusulli, permasan, psrmesan, edamamme/edemame, Arabiatta, mexian, smoced, Orion rings, Puding, withSpecial; odd punctuation 'mantar.közlenmiş biber çedar peyniri, , patates', 'Haloumi stick,,Orion rings' kept.

Category headings split at '/': 'Tost/Toasted Sandwich', 'Burger ve sıcak atıştırmalıklar  / Burger and hot snacks' (doubled space collapsed), 'BOWLLAR / Bowls', 'Pide Çeşitleri / Kind of Pittas'. 'Pizza' is single-language. Items in Kızartmalar and Pide Çeşitleri have no descriptions.
